title: B0 inference performance load matrix
description: Data-only definition of the 11 B0 load points (W01-W11) and their sequential stop/elimination conditions. This file is deliberately NOT executed by the harness-remediation effort; matrix runs are a separate authorized campaign. Each load point maps 1:1 onto the run_benchmark.py CLI (prompt-class/output-class/concurrency/requests/max-new-tokens).

matrix.purpose: Sweep concurrency at a fixed context (W01-W06), sweep context and output depth at the proven concurrency (W07-W11). W09 probes the near-window regime under the 65536-token B0 limit.

frozen_identity.notes: Change-control: B0 identity is frozen for the lifetime of the matrix. Any deviation voids the baseline and requires a new baseline id.

global_stop_conditions.condition: any load point records a sentinel-check failure (validity state FAIL, reason CORRECTNESS_FAILURE) or more than 10% of measured responses fail the deterministic content check
global_stop_conditions.action: HALT the entire matrix; no further load points execute; prior evidence is preserved and labeled

global_stop_conditions.condition: any GPU temperature reaches the abort threshold (90 C) or the required fail-closed sensor set is lost mid-run
global_stop_conditions.action: HALT the entire matrix; TELEMETRY_LOST / SAFETY_ABORT recorded

global_stop_conditions.condition: declared platform draw (2*200+250=650 W) exceeds PSU capacity minus headroom (950*0.8=760 W)
global_stop_conditions.action: HALT before execution; INVALID/POWER_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with the math recorded

global_stop_conditions.condition: the inference endpoint cannot be reached at the start of any load point
global_stop_conditions.action: HALT the entire matrix; NOT_RUN/SERVICE_UNREACHABLE recorded for the remainder

elimination_rule.condition: a load point exceeds its per-point device-error budget (device_lost + oom > 2.0% of measured requests); throughput remains an observation and never invalidates a run
elimination_rule.action: mark the load point INVALID with observations preserved and CONTINUE the matrix; the failed point is excluded from any later aggregate and flagged for capacity review

matrix.warmup: first 5 requests at each load point are warmup and are excluded from distributions and aggregates

load_points.rationale: cold start and single-request TTFT/ITL reference
first parallelism step; measures queue contention onset
representative coding-block context at low fan-out
doubles W03 fan-out to locate the throughput knee
second doubling; expects sub-linear scaling before saturation
saturation / degradation probe at the configured request fan-out ceiling
quarter-window context; checks prefill-bound TTFT and long-generation behavior
memory-pressure regime near half the window
61440 + 512 output leaves headroom under the 65536 limit; highest per-request memory pressure, kept at low fan-out for safety

load_points.description: max generation depth at single stream
load_points.rationale: longest generation profile; upper bound for end-to-end latency
steady-state throughput and thermal soak at the proven operating point

budget.estimate: upper-bound wall-clock envelope assuming cold start per point; real campaign timing scheduled separately
